## Market-Signal Decision Pipeline (reference domain)
Three trigger paths (secured webhook / schedule / manual) feed a single pipeline: fan out to 5 live data sources in parallel, build win-probabilities, loop per-Kalshi-market through the reusable `00-decision-framework.json` sub-workflow, compute the decision signal + sizing, write every decision to the `decision_ledger` (see `db/schema.sql`), then respond.

### ① Parallel ingest
Three trigger types converge on a warm-up Code node, which then fans out to 5 independent, parallel data sources: Jolpica standings, OpenF1 weather, Open-Meteo forecast, Kalshi KXF1 markets, and the Autosport RSS feed. A Merge node (combine) joins all 5 branches back into one item.

### ② Per-market loop
The merged evidence feeds a Code node that builds a softmax win-probability model (mirrors `packages/f1model/src/model.ts`), then a **Loop Over Items** node walks the Kalshi KXF1 markets one at a time (batch size 1).

### ③ Agent + LLM-judge
Each loop iteration calls the reusable `00-decision-framework.json` sub-workflow (AI Agent analyst + AI Agent judge + guardrail gate), then a Code node computes the decision signal and sizing (mirrors `packages/f1model/src/edge.ts`) before looping back.

### ④ Governance gate + ledger
Once the loop is done, every decision is inserted into Postgres `decision_ledger` (see `db/schema.sql`), an If node checks whether any candidate produced an ACT recommendation, and the webhook caller (if any) gets a JSON response.
